unit: User-owned Kamoer pump; machine BOM KPHM600-SW3B17, repository compatibility directory kamoer-kphm400
status: two complementary native scans; bounded contact corrections implemented; physical corrected assembly not yet accepted
native_cloud_processing: No isolation or smoothing. Putty, support fixtures and markers retained in raw clouds; analysis selects named rigid regions.

outlet_authority.statement: There are 1/4-inch LLDPE tube stubs, very short ones, inserted into the Kamoer pump silicone in these scans.
classification: Rigid molded casing roots are measured separately.
Terminal LLDPE pieces are inserted external tubing, not integral rigid barbs.
outlet_authority.registration_exclusion: Entire outlet stack withheld from scan-to-scan rigid registration; only rigid casing roots are used for independent station comparison.

native_baseline.note: Generated native exports are external archived evidence, not tracked git artifacts. Source commit is context, not a substitute for their content digests.

measurement_sampling: Every sixth native observation after proper rigid registration; original float coordinates are neither smoothed nor scaled.
limits: No global CAD fit. Fitted holder-derived head geometry is not an independent scan target.
Scale fixed at 1; scanner residuals do not establish absolute dimensional accuracy. Spray thickness is unmeasured.
Head transverse Y datum remains provisional; scan motor axis is aligned to the native rear motor opening, retaining the existing -1 mm head/rear-stack relationship.
No claims for pump internals, sealed cavities, material stiffness, screw torque or long-term endurance.
physical_acceptance: Dry assemble both pumps in the corrected cradle and cap: skirt lands carry each pump, front rim clears floor, and cap tightening removes vertical play before a printed/screw hard stop.
Verify straight cartridge insertion/withdrawal and separate upward pump/cap removal.
Confirm all four inserted tube depths, collet capture, carrier release and flexible-outlet alignment; run a primed pump/leak test.
